metas.name: 1 · ★ 5.8 · 1992 · Beethoven
metas.description: A slobbering St. Bernard becomes the center of attention for George and Alice Newton's loving family, who must contend with dog-napping local veterinarian Dr. Herman Varnick and his henchmen Harvey and Vernon.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.0 · 1993 · Beethoven's 2nd
metas.description: Beethoven, the St. Bernard dog, becomes a father, but his girlfriend Missy is dognapped, and his puppies are in danger of the same fate.
